newsitem.title: USA: Dow industrials rally at start of Wall Street trade.
newsitem.headline: Dow industrials rally at start of Wall Street trade.

text.p: Wall Street stocks moved higher with bonds at the start of trading on Friday after weaker than expected February producer price index and capacity utilisation data boosted bonds and eased fears of a Fed tightening.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was up 20 points at 6,899 while the Nasdaq Composite gained six to 1,299 and the S&P Index was up one at 790.
The 30-year long bond was up 7/32 to yield 6.94 percent.
